item.title: News briefs
item.description: Editor’s note: Organizations in The Register-Herald’s coverage area are encouraged to submit scheduled events and news for the weekly News Briefs. Items can be emailed to emowen@aimmediamidwest.com. Deadline for inclusion in the Wednesday edition is 5 p.m. the Friday prior; deadline for inclusion in the Saturday edition is 5 p.m. the Wednesday prior. Items are published as space allows until the date of events has passed, or for ongoing listings, until removal is requested. The post News briefs

item.title: Downtown Eaton Awards 2025 Business Exterior Improvement Matching Grants
item.description: EATON — Downtown Eaton announced Monday, Feb. 2, the presentation of grant reimbursement checks to two downtown property owners who have completed improvement projects through the 2025 Downtown Eaton Business Exterior Improvement Matching Grant Program. The post Downtown Eaton Awards 2025 Business Exterior Improvement Matching Grants appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Annual Ticket Auction celebrates America’s 250th anniversary while supporting Preble County seniors
item.description: EATON — Preble County Council on Aging will host its Annual Ticket Auction on Thursday, Feb. 13, at the Preble County Senior Center, with doors opening at 5 p.m. and the auction beginning at 6 p.m. The post Annual Ticket Auction celebrates America’s 250th anniversary while supporting Preble County seniors appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Harrison Township supporting Clay Township
item.description: LEWISBURG — Harrison Township has issued a statement expressing support for neighboring Clay Township in Montgomery County regarding a proposed township division initiative being promoted by a group calling itself the “North West Initiative.” The post Harrison Township supporting Clay Township appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Trustees to place fire, rescue levy on ballot
item.description: CLAY TOWNSHIP — The trustees voted Feb. 3 to place a 2.5-mill levy for fire and rescue service for the township on the May 5 ballot. The post Trustees to place fire, rescue levy on ballot appeared first on The Register Herald.
